summary: Verified Stripe payments Flow A integration (checkout + status) plus existing leads flow. 13/13 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend /pricing renders all 3 plan cards + banner and successfully redirects to checkout.stripe.com when clicking CTA. /payment/cancel renders correctly. Homepage still loads.

issues: A 'Preparing Smarter Business Systems...' loading label overlaps with the hero animation illustration on desktop. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py catches only stripe.error.InvalidRequestError for managed_payments fallback; other Stripe errors (e.g. missing eligibility) will bubble as 500 which is fine, but the invalid lookup_key path uses HTTPException(500,...) — consider 400 since it is a client-provided key.
GET /api/payments/status calls Stripe on every request until paid; consider caching or rate-limit for polling.
No auth on /api/payments/checkout — anyone can create sessions; acceptable for MVP sandbox but flag for prod.
seed_data_creation: None. Real Stripe test-mode sessions were created against the sandbox catalog (starter/business/growth) as part of tests; payment_transactions collection has multiple 'pending/initiated' rows now.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe Flow A sandbox is live and lookup_keys resolve correctly. Checkout returns URL under checkout.stripe.com. /api/payments/status returns pending for uncompleted sessions and 404 for unknown session_ids. Do not complete Stripe hosted checkout in automation.
